cohort_total_n_excerpt: Population-based case-control study of 858 men aged <70 years at diagnosis with histologically confirmed prostate cancer of Gleason Grade 5 or greater, and 905 age-frequency-matched men, selected at random from the electoral rolls.
reason: The cases had histologically confirmed prostate cancer with a Gleason Grade threshold of 5 or greater. The abstract does not characterize this threshold as high-grade or aggressive, and it does not report a distinct advanced, metastatic, high-risk, or lethal endpoint; therefore aggressive incidence is not established.
